llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的电化学行为，而非力学性能或疲劳性能，与用户方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper investigates electrochemical corrosion behavior, not mechanical or fatigue properties of Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究不同建造方向对增材制造Ti-6Al-4V电化学行为的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过电化学测试分析不同建造方向试样的耐腐蚀性能。
summary_zh.result: 建造方向影响电化学行为，但未涉及力学或疲劳性能。
summary_zh.validation: 电化学实验验证，无力学测试。

summary_en.motivation: To study the effect of build orientation on the electrochemical behavior of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: Electrochemical tests were conducted on specimens with different build orientations to evaluate corrosion resistance.
summary_en.result: Build orientation influences electrochemical behavior, but no mechanical or fatigue data are reported.
summary_en.validation: Validation through electrochemical experiments only, without mechanical testing.
